text: This report recommends that the name "Gwen Egan Lane" be approved to identify a public lane north of Bernard Avenue, extending between Madison Avenue and Huron Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Gwen Egan Lane" for a public lane north of Bernard Avenue, extending between Madison Avenue and Huron Street.
